messages:
Sam: Heads up — saw a ~3x spike in late mobile events for the 02:00 hour, causing a cascade of recompute jobs to queue.
Nisha: ugh. is this the SDK batching rollback that went out last week?
Sam: looks correlated. mobile ingestion timestamps are delayed ~20-40m. lots of agg-hours backfills kicked off.
Arthur: what does the console show for backfill concurrency? any throttles hitting SLA buckets?
console-bot: Backfill job queue length: 437; active jobs: 62; avg job runtime: 7m; preemption events: 3
Diego: we should avoid kicking full-priority reprocess for every tenant. cost spike risk.
Tanya: agreed. proposal: add a short-lived `priority_override` API flag that ops can set for urgent customers only, and have console UX to gate it.
Nisha: careful: that's basically an admin backdoor. need audit + quota cost check and a soft cooldown.
Sam: proto payload I used for a manual run:
```
POST /internal/recompute
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-42",
  "window": "2026-03-20T02:00:00Z/2026-03-20T03:00:00Z",
  "mode": "agg-hours",
  "priority_override": true,
  "reason": "mobile_event_lag"
}
```
Arthur: if we add that flag we need routing policy changes: don't route to Dedicated tier unless tenant has reserved capacity.
Diego: also: quota accounting must charge estimated token-hours to tenant billing center before start. otherwise finance will scream.
Tanya: console UX: show cost estimate + cooldown timer + forced justification field. plus checkbox for "apply KV rehydrate" which has big perf impact.
Nisha: KV rehydrate toggle is key. If rehydrate=true we get much faster downstream reads but spike GPU memory for cache fills.
Sam: ops-bot flagged 12 tenants with >100k late events. we should bulk-soft-summarize then offer manual escalation via UI.
ops-bot: Note: escalation requests without `justification` will be rejected by API.
Diego: we can implement a floor: allow `priority_override` only if tenant_usage_rank <= 200 OR support_ticket_open = true.
Arthur: sounds sane. also need guardrails: max concurrent overrides global = 5, per-tenant cooldown = 6h.
Tanya: UX wire: modal shows estimated compute cost, projected finish ETA, checkbox for KV rehydrate (exp +$), and a radio for rollback vs full recompute.
Nisha: put a telemetry marker `recompute.triggered_via=console` vs `=api` and include `override_reason` label for evals.
Sam: for immediate triage: I'll run a targeted partial rehydrate for top 5 affected tenants with KV=false and monitor.
console-bot: Action logged: Sam initiated partial rehydrate for 5 tenants at 6483210600.
Diego: after that we should add an API validation: if priority_override && estimated_cost > tenant_remaining_budget => require billing approval token.
Arthur: agree. add audit events + webhook to billing to lock if necessary.
Tanya: OK — next steps: (1) Nisha + Diego to draft API contract + validation (2) Arthur to sketch routing policy changes (3) Sam to run the partials and report perf numbers in 30m (4) I will mock the modal and cost calc.
Nisha: will also add the telemetry fields and a sample dashboard tile: "Overridden Recomputes" with cost & finish ETA.
Sam: thanks all, keeping this thread updated. ping me @Sam if you want join the run.
console-bot: Reminder: create support ticket for tenant acme-42 before full override.
